title: Back-Dating Reach of a Home Oxygen Therapy Suspension by Coverage Class
content:
# Back-Dating Reach of a Suspension — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Schedule rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy suspension, the evidence day dates the suspension only when it is no more than the reach below, in calendar days, before the day the stay is reported. The reach depends on the coverage named on the oxygen record, read by its coverage class in the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. When the condition fails, the suspension is dated on the day the stay is reported.

| Coverage class named on the oxygen record | Reach (calendar days before the day the stay is reported) |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 365 |
| Commercial PPO | 180 |
| Commercial HMO | 180 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 180 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 180 |
| any other coverage class (for example Medicaid Fee-for-Service) | 90 |

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical)

| Coverage class | Evidence day, days before the report | Evidence day dates the suspension |
|---|---|---|
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 365 | yes, as far as the reach goes |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 366 | no: dated on the day the stay is reported |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 180 | yes, as far as the reach goes |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 181 | no: dated on the day the stay is reported |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 90 | yes, as far as the reach goes |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 91 | no: dated on the day the stay is reported |

Days are counted as the later date (the day the stay is reported) less the earlier date (the evidence day).
